title: Mack Trident FUPS Road Train Bullbar #15
description: Mack Trident hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Security mesh bolted to back of uprights (can be chrome plated). Reversible aluminium Road Train signs, cowcatcher and 4 gussets. Heavy duty tow pin mounted in heavy duty steel backing plate. Indicator repeaters mounted in main bar. Driving light mounts as requested. Provision for front mudflaps. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
